title: Rise and Shine Pancakes
description: Paleo pancakes made from egg, ground cinnamon and grated apple. The ultimate quick breakfast — mixed and cooked in minutes.
steps: Beat the egg in a medium bowl and add the cinnamon.
Peel and very finely grate the apple into the egg mixture. Blend well. Cover tightly with cling film and leave for at least 30 minutes to thicken.
Heat a knob of butter in a medium frying pan. Drop the batter in blobs of 2 heaped tablespoons, a few centimetres apart.
Cook over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly browned underneath. Flip and cook for another few minutes.
Serve with natural yoghurt, more grated apple, icing sugar or chopped nuts.
notes: Each batch (2 pancakes) serves 1. Multiply as needed. Also works with mashed banana instead of apple.
